summary: Santa Rosa County, FL lookout filed under the Choctawhatchee National Forest; OSM tags it an observation tower. No source dates it or describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: a directory listing, an OSM node and a general forest history. No source gives a build date, builder, design, staffing, fires, status or access, and the site today is undescribed. The story is about 110 words, under the 120-word guide floor, because nothing more is sourced. Verification 2026-10-21: reworded the Niceville sentence so it no longer says the caption places a tower at the station (it only mentions a lookout tower in a photo of the station), and reworded the Forest Service sentence to paraphrase rather than copy the quote. The Niceville photo caption concerns a different station, not this tower. Search results placed Weaver Creek on Eglin AFB in botanical records, but those pages returned HTTP 502 and were not used. The record's elevation (40 m) comes from OSM and was not checked. The record's agency field carries a stray '>' (see corrections). Consider holding this story until a Florida Forest Service or Eglin source surfaces.
